features.description: Nuclear pore complex protein Nup214 phenylalanine-glycine (FG)
Required for interaction with DVL2 and SUDS3
Mediates interaction with NEK2 and is required for its function in the suppression of centrosome disjunction
Required for centrosome localization and for its function in the suppression of centrosome disjunction
Required for localization to nuclear speckles
SUMO interaction motifs (SIM); required for nuclear localization and kinase activity
Necessary and sufficient for interaction with PAX7
